# AdsX

> A publication about Shopify, Whop, ecommerce, apps, advertising, and AI. AdsX is also developing a free Shopify app for third-party offers on Thank you and Order status pages, with merchant revenue sharing. App availability and terms have not been announced.

## Publication
- [Topics](https://www.adsx.com/topics): Curated reading paths.
- [Start a store](https://www.adsx.com/topics/start-a-store): Platform decisions and setup.
- [Whop business guides](https://www.adsx.com/topics/whop): Ecommerce and AI, services, coaching and courses, paid communities, payments, and platforms.
- [Shopify apps](https://www.adsx.com/topics/shopify-apps): Selection, costs, and permissions.
- [Running a store](https://www.adsx.com/topics/running-a-store): Order confirmation, customer experience, and offer economics.
- [AI in commerce](https://www.adsx.com/topics/ai-commerce): Workflows and product discovery.
- [Advertising](https://www.adsx.com/topics/advertising): Measurement and acquisition.
- [Development](https://www.adsx.com/topics/development): Shopify APIs and extensions.
- [Latest articles](https://www.adsx.com/blog)
- [RSS feed](https://www.adsx.com/feed.xml)

## Whop starting points
- [Ecommerce launch](https://www.adsx.com/blog/whop-ecommerce-launch-2026): October 1 announcement, native store capabilities, and merchant checks.
- [Service businesses](https://www.adsx.com/blog/whop-for-service-businesses): Scope, payment, and delivery.
- [Online courses](https://www.adsx.com/blog/whop-create-online-course): Learning outcomes, course setup, and paid access.
- [Paid communities](https://www.adsx.com/blog/whop-paid-community-guide): Recurring value and the first month.
- [Platforms and marketplaces](https://www.adsx.com/blog/whop-for-platforms-marketplaces): Connected accounts and payment operations.

## Product and policies
- [AdsX app](https://www.adsx.com/app): In development.
- [About](https://www.adsx.com/about)

## Free tools
- [Whop launch checklist](https://www.adsx.com/resources/whop-launch-checklist): An interactive review of offer, payment, delivery, and support.
- [Shopify startup cost calculator](https://www.adsx.com/tools/shopify-startup-cost-calculator): Upfront budget, monthly costs, break-even orders, and a downloadable worksheet.
- [ROAS calculator](https://www.adsx.com/tools/roas-calculator)
- [Feed readiness checker](https://www.adsx.com/tools/feed-readiness-checker)

AdsX participates in Shopify's affiliate program and Whop's partner referral program. AdsX owner Dennis Hegstad is employed at Whop. AdsX also seeks affiliate revenue from relevant Shopify apps; coverage alone does not establish a paid partnership. Commercial signup links may earn commissions; editorial documentation links stay direct. Pricing and eligibility depend on the merchant's location and current provider terms. This file is a navigation aid; it is not a requirement for inclusion in AI search.
